# toOcl boundary fixtures

These eight small SDF records are unchanged copies of the independently frozen
20-case automatic-3D source corpus (manifest ac91e192...). They cover opposite
specified tetrahedra, isotope stereo, two cyclic centers, E/Z, an unspecified
center, and interspersed explicit hydrogens. Expected source configurations were
frozen before this implementation. Worker tests also reuse accepted ordinary
source-stereo fixtures; no new engine-generated expected values are authored.
